```yaml
name: Test Copilot GitHub Integration

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  test-copilot-integration:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with:
          go-version: '1.21'
          cache: true

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: go mod download

      - name: Run unit tests
        run: go test ./... -v -coverprofile=coverage.out

      - name: Build CLI
        run: go build -o gh-aw ./cmd/gh-aw

      - name: Test default behavior (writes instructions)
        run: |
          mkdir -p test-default
          cd test-default
          echo "name: test" > workflow.md
          ../gh-aw compile workflow.md
          # Verify instruction files are created by default
          test -f .github/instructions/github-agentic-workflows.instructions.md || (echo "Missing instructions file"; exit 1)
          test -f .github/prompts/create-agentic-workflow.prompt.md || (echo "Missing prompt file"; exit 1)
          echo "Default behavior test passed: instruction files created"

      - name: Test --no-instructions flag
        run: |
          mkdir -p test-no-instructions
          cd test-no-instructions
          echo "name: test" > workflow.md
          ../gh-aw compile workflow.md --no-instructions
          # Verify instruction files are NOT created
          test ! -f .github/instructions/github-agentic-workflows.instructions.md || (echo "Instructions file should not exist"; exit 1)
          test ! -f .github/prompts/create-agentic-workflow.prompt.md || (echo "Prompt file should not exist"; exit 1)
          echo "No-instructions flag test passed: instruction files not created"

      - name: Test --no-emit flag (skips instructions and lock files)
        run: |
          mkdir -p test-no-emit
          cd test-no-emit
          echo "name: test" > workflow.md
          ../gh-aw compile workflow.md --no-emit
          # Verify instruction files are NOT created when using --no-emit
          test ! -f .github/instructions/github-agentic-workflows.instructions.md || (echo "Instructions file should not exist with --no-emit"; exit 1)
          test ! -f .github/prompts/create-agentic-workflow.prompt.md || (echo "Prompt file should not exist with --no-emit"; exit 1)
          test ! -f .github/workflows/lockfile.json || (echo "Lock file should not exist with --no-emit"; exit 1)
          echo "No-emit flag test passed: instruction and lock files not created"

      - name: Upload coverage report
        uses: codecov/codecov-action@v3
        if: always()
        with:
          files: ./coverage.out
          fail_ci_if_error: false
```
